$comment: The layout ratchet's allowlist for the Java generators (ADR-0063). `unconverted`: generator source that still types its own layout; each entry names what it emits and the writer PR that converts it, and is removed when that PR lands (the test fails while a converted file keeps its entry). `exempt`: source that writes text which is not generated code; each says why. Neither list may grow: LayoutRatchetTest compares it with the copy at the branch's merge base.

unconverted.codegen-base/src/main/java/com/metaobjec: Builds the FileIndentor with a hand-typed two-space indentation unit, the older indentor pipeline under the object code generators. Converts with the Java small generators and polish writer PR (W-JV-5).
Emits the generated entity Extractor class by string concatenation with hand-typed line breaks and indentation. Converts with the Java small generators and polish writer PR (W-JV-5).
Configures the older object code writer with a hand-typed four-space indentation unit. Converts with the Java small generators and polish writer PR (W-JV-5).
Emits the plain Java object class by string concatenation with hand-typed line breaks and indentation. Converts with the Java small generators and polish writer PR (W-JV-5).
unconverted.codegen-spring/src/main/java/com/metaobj: Emits the Java code samples shown in the generated API docs by string concatenation with hand-typed line breaks and indentation. Converts with the Java small generators and polish writer PR (W-JV-5).
Emits the JUnit requirement test classes by string concatenation with hand-typed line breaks and indentation. Converts with the Java small generators and polish writer PR (W-JV-5).
Emits the LLM trace helper class by string concatenation with hand-typed line breaks and indentation. Converts with the Java small generators and polish writer PR (W-JV-5).
Emits the filter allowlist class by string concatenation with hand-typed line breaks and indentation. Converts with the Java small generators and polish writer PR (W-JV-5).

Writes the package line of a generated file with a typed line break. Converts with the Java DTO, parser, names, repository and report export writer PR (W-JV-4), when that package line comes from JavaWriter.packageName().
Emits the output parser class by string concatenation with hand-typed line breaks and indentation. Converts with the Java DTO, parser, names, repository and report export writer PR (W-JV-4).
Emits the output prompt class by string concatenation with hand-typed line breaks and indentation. Converts with the Java small generators and polish writer PR (W-JV-5).
Emits the render helper class by string concatenation with hand-typed line breaks and indentation. Converts with the Java small generators and polish writer PR (W-JV-5).

exempt.codegen-base/src/main/java/com/metaobjec: Builds the text of an exception message with typed line breaks. It is a diagnostic for the person running the build, not code an adopter edits.
Builds the one-paragraph configuration summary used in log output with typed line breaks. It is a diagnostic, not generated code.
Builds the one-paragraph configuration summary used in log output with typed line breaks. It is a diagnostic, not generated code.

Emits the HTML metadata documentation page with its stylesheet. Documentation output is exempt from the writer conversion (ADR-0063; the docs and markdown emitters), because it is not code an adopter edits.
Reads and writes the hash manifest, a line-based data file the tool owns and no adopter edits. It is not generated code.
exempt.codegen-plantuml/src/main/java/com/metao: Emits PlantUML diagram text. A diagram is documentation output, exempt from the writer conversion (ADR-0063), and not code an adopter edits.
